units.text: Supporting Information Synthesis and Characterization of Water-Soluble Polythiophene Derivatives for Cell Imaging

1 H NMR spectra of PT-DDA, PT-ADA and the corresponding monomers. The solvent was CDCl 3 for (a) and (b), and d 6 -DMSO for (c). Co-location imaging of WSPTs (20 M in RUs: PT-ADA, PT-DDA or PT-ADA-PPR) and Lyso Tracker Blue DND-22 (0.5 μmol/L) in A549 cells. (a) phase contrast image; (b) fluorescence image of Lyso Tracker Blue DND-22 (excitation: 405 nm; collection: 415 to 460 nm); (c) fluorescence image of WSPTs (excitation: 488 nm; collection: 540 to 640 nm); (d) overlapped image of (b) and (c). The false color is blue for Lyso Tracker Blue DND-22, and red for WSPTs.
